newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra cut at JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra cut at JP Morgan.

text.p: Swedish drug group Astra AB was cut to "market performer" at JP Morgan, the investment bank said on Friday.

The brokerage said its analysis suggested the company's stockpile was significantly higher than the 400 million Swedish crowns that the company had announced and Astra's expenses on items such as research had risen sharply in the fourth quarter.
It said its fundamental view on Astra remained of above-average growth in sales and earnings but that Astra's management had not sufficiently explained recent worrying trends.
JP Morgan calculated a fair value for the stock in a range between 297 crowns and 316 crowns. It closed at 305 crowns on Thursday.
